name: My Last War
source:
At the beginning of the 20th century, a conflict known as The Great War ravaged Europe, destroying most of its cities and wiping off an entire generation of adult men and women.

Amidst the ruins of old Europe, teenagers fight a war they themselves didn't start.

After experiencing a revealing dream, 19-year-old sergeant Maria Strauss decides she will do whatever it takes to stop the war. 

Can she do it? Will she succeed where so many others have failed?
